about: The clip queue. The daily run takes the first jobs with status "todo" (about 5 to 8 a day on the free allowance). To add a job, copy one and change it; see clips/README.md.

jobs.uses: Level 4: the Interpreter lifts his open hand as he explains (in the game since build 278, assets/room-interpreter-say.webp)
Level 4: the candle-lit passage between rooms, the door, leaving; any later level where he walks
jobs.prompt: An old grave kind man in a long red-brown gown and a dark skull-cap walks slowly and steadily to the RIGHT, his hands folded in front of him, an unhurried dignified walk. The camera moves along with him and does NOT zoom: he stays in the centre of the frame at exactly the same size, his whole body always visible; he walks on the spot in the frame with even, regular steps, so the walk can loop.

jobs.uses: Level 4: the passage and leaving in the painted manner; later painted rooms (Palace Beautiful, Level 7)
jobs.prompt: A pilgrim in a worn hooded cloak with a great bundle tied with rope on his back walks slowly and steadily to the RIGHT, bent a little under the weight, his hands empty. The camera moves along with him and does NOT zoom: he stays in the centre of the frame at exactly the same size, his whole body always visible; he walks on the spot in the frame with even, regular steps, so the walk can loop.

jobs.uses: Level 4 room 2: the damsel pours and the sweeper sweeps, laid back into the still painting
jobs.prompt: The young woman slowly pours a thin stream of water from her red-brown jug onto the floor, and the man beside her slowly sweeps the floor with his broom; fine dust drifts in the window light. The camera is completely still: no zoom, no pan, no cut. Only the people and the light move; the room, the walls and every object stay exactly where they are. Keep the oil-painting style and colours exactly.

jobs.uses: Level 4 room 4: the fire burns and flickers, the man keeps casting water on it, steam rises; behind the wall the oil is poured
jobs.prompt: The fire burns and flickers higher, the man keeps casting water on it from his wooden bucket and steam rises; behind the wall the man in the long robe slowly pours oil from his jug. The camera is completely still: no zoom, no pan, no cut. Only the people and the light move; the room, the walls and every object stay exactly where they are. Keep the oil-painting style and colours exactly.

jobs.uses: Level 4 room 5: the brave man puts on his helmet and draws his sword; Apollyon (Level 8) if Christian arms the same way
jobs.prompt: A strong plain man in a long brown coat puts a steel helmet on his head and draws his sword, then strides forward to the RIGHT, determined.

jobs.uses: Level 4 gate: Good-will reaches out with both hands to pull Christian in (the father's hands in Rembrandt's Prodigal Son); played back, he folds his hands again
jobs.prompt: An old bare-headed man with a short white beard and a long gown and cloak, his hands folded, leans forward and reaches out low with both hands, warmly, as if to take hold of someone and draw them in.

jobs.uses: Level 4: looking up at the picture (room 1), at the light (room 7), at the palace (room 5); Level 5 looking up at the Cross
jobs.prompt: The pilgrim with the great bundle on his back stands still, slowly lifts his head to look up at something high in front of him, holds the look a moment in wonder, then slowly lowers his head again.

jobs.uses: Level 4: the Interpreter listening while Christian speaks, in every room
jobs.prompt: The old man with folded hands stands still, breathing quietly, and slowly nods his head once or twice, kindly, as if listening and agreeing.

jobs.uses: Level 4 room 7: the man risen from his bed trembles and stares up in awe
jobs.prompt: The man sitting up in the curtained bed trembles, breathing hard, staring up in awe and fear; his hand grips the bedclothes; the curtains stir very slightly. The camera is completely still: no zoom, no pan, no cut. Only the people and the light move; the room, the walls and every object stay exactly where they are. Keep the oil-painting style and colours exactly.

jobs.uses: Level 4: turning round in the rooms and at the door; any painted room later
jobs.prompt: The pilgrim with the great bundle on his back slowly turns round on the spot, from facing right to facing left, his feet stepping round in place.

jobs.uses: Level 4 room 5: the brave man striding through the guards (a loop)
jobs.prompt: A man in a steel helmet and breastplate, sword drawn, strides steadily and boldly to the RIGHT. The camera moves along with him and does NOT zoom: he stays in the centre of the frame at exactly the same size, his whole body always visible; he walks on the spot in the frame with even, regular steps, so the walk can loop.

jobs.uses: Level 5, the Cross: the burden loosens, falls from his back and tumbles away (an experiment: no last picture yet)
jobs.prompt: The pilgrim stands still; the ropes holding the great bundle on his back loosen by themselves, the bundle slips from his shoulders, falls behind him and tumbles away out of the picture; he straightens up, lighter, and stands tall.
